Interactive prototype · Scope & limitations

Separate from the live app. Full production flour and pizza catalogs and original pizza filtering/shopping aggregation are included. All account, weather, scan, Maestro and public-share services are offline; no request is sent. Local files and photo previews remain in this page.

Dough quantities and times are illustrative fixtures, not validated baking instructions. Editing climate does not run the production fermentation engine. The schedule lets you move planned actions and edit unavailable periods; a source-shaped illustrative fermentation curve is available, but production model inputs, starter curves and the automatic solver are not connected. Explicit saves stay in this browser; cloud sync is not connected. Unsaved changes can be lost on reload. English product chrome is complete; French catalog content is available, with some navigation copy untranslated.
